title: Synapse: Pinned Lanes & Compact Viewport Navigation
creator: Ava Mason
description: Problem: The current console navigation fragments key workflows (dashboards, rollouts, cost views) across multiple rails and modal flows. Users working across teams frequently lose context when switching between tenant-level dashboards, model rollouts, and per-route cost lenses. Goals: (1) create a compact, low-noise primary rail that surfaces high-value lanes (Metrics, Rollouts, Cost, Models, Routes) while keeping per-route context pinned; (2) enable a lightweight workspace carousel for rapid account/workspace switching without losing open panels; (3) design an IA that supports rollout A/B views and cost breakdowns without excessive clicks. Constraints: keep left-rail to <= 72px collapsed width; preserve keyboard-first flows; ensure accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA); minimal infra changes to routing (prefer route params over heavy client state).
design_decisions: Primary rail uses icon-first compact affordances with optional hover labels for discoverability
Pinned lane state persists per workspace and is encoded in URL as ?pinned=metrics,rollouts to allow shareable links
Workspace carousel is a horizontally scrollable micro-tray that preserves open panel sets as named sessions
Cost lenses open as contextual right-side overlays (not full route navigations) to maintain parent dashboard context
tradeoffs: Encoding pinned state in the URL increases surface area for edge-case routing bugs but improves shareability and deep-linking
Compact rail reduces discoverability for low-frequency features; we mitigate with progressive disclosure and keyboard shortcuts
Keeping cost views as overlays preserves context but complicates snapshotting for external analytics exports
risks: Potential regressive behavior on low-resolution screens where collapsed rail may hide critical lanes
Syncing pinned lanes across browser tabs requires session coordination; fallback is server-side persisted preferences which adds backend work
Performance: dynamically animating carousel on constrained devices may affect perceived latency
acceptance_criteria: Collapsed rail at 72px shows 6 prioritized lanes; hover reveals label text within 200ms
Pinned lanes persist after workspace switch and are reflected in the URL; deep-link opens same pinned set
Workspace carousel can restore a named session including open dashboard panel state within 1 second on SSD-backed clients
Cost overlay displays token-level cost breakdown for the selected route and supports export to CSV
Design passes accessibility audit (color contrast, keyboard nav, ARIA labels) documented in handoff

review_feedback: PM (R. Kaur): favor the overlay approach for cost views but ensure exportability and schedulable reports
Eng (S. Patel): prefer URL-encoded pinned state and warn about max URL length; will prototype router middleware
Security (L. Chen): flagged need to audit persisted workspace session payloads for sensitive tokens; suggested KMS-sponsored storage patterns for session keys
Design Lead (M. Ortiz): good direction; refine micro-animations and ensure high-contrast icons for grayscale printing
usability_findings: Participants expected a persistent breadcrumb when switching workspaces — resolved in prototype by keeping open panel chip in carousel
Two participants didn't discover cost overlay when rail collapsed; adding a subtle pulsing affordance on first-run improved discovery in follow-up prototype
Keyboard testing revealed the need for deterministic focus order across carousel items and pinned lanes
